# Typed IR schemas for facts and knowledge

Defines Pydantic models representing the Fact IR (artifact, fact, extraction, anchor) and the Knowledge IR (entity, relationship) as well as delta/change structures. These typed schemas provide a consistent in-process representation for compiler components to produce, consume, and transmit IR objects.
